title: Brazilian Roast Chicken with Roasted Vegetables
description: A delicious and flavorful chicken dish roasted with a mix of vegetables, inspired by the cuisine of Brazil.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the chicken for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
Toss the Brussels sprouts, bell pepper, and onion with a little bit of oil and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the chicken with the roasted vegetables and enjoy!
